chapter: Becoming a musician and the organ trio
title: Organ players he has worked with
summary: He lists organists he has worked with, including Charlie Earland, Jack McDuff, Joey DeFrancesco and Jimmy Smith, 'the king'.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Tell us about some of the great organ players you’ve worked with.

Oh, boy, I’ve worked with them all. Charlie Earland, Jack McDuff, Sonny Phillips, Joey DeFrancesco, oh boy, Groove Holmes, Johnny Hammond Smith. Yeah. I’ve worked with a lot of organ players, and they were all good. They were the greatest. I also worked with Jimmy Smith, who is the king, so I worked with a lot of them.
